question.prompt: Each edge of a cube is increased by \(50\%.\) The percent of increase of the surface area of the cube is:

solutions.explanation:
A cube has six square faces, so an edge of length \(s>0\) gives surface area \(6s^2\). Increasing the edge by \(50\%\) changes its length to \(1.5s\), giving new surface area
\[
6(1.5s)^2=2.25(6s^2).
\]
Thus the new area is \(225\%\) of the original area. The increase is
\[
225\%-100\%=125\%.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{125\%}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
solutions.title: Compare the old and new surface areas
